compiler_guard_clause: 多图引用只能有一个STATE_AUTHORITY负责空间、机位、人物站位和尺度；任何含冲突建筑几何的辅助图必须删除，不能只用否定词隔离；关键洞口和道具尺寸必须用人体肩宽、身高与净空等实物关系表达。
optimization: Remove the conflicting concept reference, retain one STATE_AUTHORITY predecessor, and express the opening with shoulder width, standing height and physical clearance.
root_cause: A STYLE_ONLY concept reference contained a larger opening and leaked incompatible geometry over the predecessor state authority.

compiler_guard_clause: 群体反应中唯一剧情道具必须逐人锁定：只允许唯一所有者持有；每个非所有者必须给出双手可见的具体空手接触动作，禁止使用全员抱胸等同构姿态，尾帧只允许一个该道具。
optimization: Name the sole prop owner and give every non-owner a different explicit empty-hand contact with both hands visible and no prop-shaped object.
root_cause: Generic group protective reactions gave multiple actors similar chest-clutching poses, so the model copied the unique ledger into a non-owner's arms.

compiler_guard_clause: 连续长镜相邻关键帧必须先通过摄影机轨迹可达性检查：逐帧声明camera_side、camera_position、camera_facing与continuous_camera_path；若摄影机无法在给定时间内沿真实空间连续到达下一机位，必须删除或重建参考图，禁止只靠同一地点或同一洞口文字掩盖反打轴线冲突。
optimization: Bind camera side, position, facing and path for every adjacent pair; remove or rebuild any reference that is not continuously reachable in the allotted time.
root_cause: Adjacent keyframes kept the same aperture but placed the camera on incompatible interior and exterior axes, so the model concealed the impossible move with a cut.

compiler_guard_clause: 凡镜头含账页、药屉标签、文书、牌匾或任何可读文字面，生成提示词必须改为无字空白材质板并声明TEXT_LAYER_POST_ONLY；精确文字只允许由AgentCut真实字体层注入，禁止让图像或视频模型绘字。
optimization: Make every generated paper, drawer label, document and sign a blank textless material plate. Inject exact plot text only as a real-font AgentCut layer after generation.
root_cause: The prompt asked the generative model to depict ledger writing and medicine-drawer labels, producing pseudo-Chinese glyphs that failed the OCR hard gate.

compiler_guard_clause: 对白镜头先声明DIALOGUE_MODE。ON_CAMERA_NATIVE_LIP_SYNC不得把完整中文字形写入视觉提示词，必须绑定独立音频参考、说话人和时段并由画面人物原生说出；CLOSED_MOUTH_VOICE_OVER必须全程闭口且不得声称口型同步；精确字幕只由AgentCut真实字体层渲染。
optimization: Separate exact glyphs from the provider visual prompt without separating synchronized performance from its bound audio. Use a typed dialogue mode: native visible speech is driven by an audio reference and timing contract; deliberate voice-over uses a closed mouth and is labeled as voice-over through assembly and QA.
root_cause: Including exact Chinese dialogue in the video prompt caused the model to burn captions into the source despite a no-subtitle negative instruction.

compiler_guard_clause: 三拍以上动作长镜禁止仅凭文字时间轴提交；必须先生成并验收不少于三张有序STATE_AUTHORITY关键帧，逐帧锁定全角色动作、接触点、人体比例和特效最大占画面比例，再按相邻状态串行生成。
optimization: Generate and approve at least three ordered state-authority frames for contact start, counterattack midpoint and rebound tail. Lock every visible actor, contact point, body-relative scale and effect maximum before video interpolation.
root_cause: A 15-second action take used identity references plus a text timeline but no state-authority action keyframes; the model enlarged thin contact ice into a table-scale river and dropped the assassin, powder, paper wall and multi-actor causal chain.

compiler_guard_clause: 连续动作状态图若前态已锁定全员身份，后态默认只引用前态，不重复注入全套身份图；提示词必须声明精确总人数、每名角色唯一服色与空间职责，并硬拒绝新增、复制、融合或拆分角色。
optimization: Use the accepted predecessor as the sole state authority for the next action-state image. Declare the exact actor count, wardrobe-color count, unique role mapping and no-add/no-duplicate contract before describing the changed action.
root_cause: The transition prompt combined the accepted predecessor with four extra identity references but did not bind an exact inherited roster count, so the image model copied the gray assassin and produced five humans instead of four.

compiler_guard_clause: 凡镜头可见两名及以上角色，提交前必须生成VISIBLE_ACTOR_MOTION_LEDGER：逐人声明起点、连续路径、接触或避让对象、终点与最大静止时长；每0.5秒至少两名可见角色发生可辨身体位移，任何角色同姿态不得超过0.7秒，禁止循环手势、表情替代动作、静止背景和重复帧填时。
optimization: Compress the action budget, assign every visible actor a start position, path, contact or avoidance response, and terminal position, and require visible body displacement at sub-second intervals. Explicitly reject held poses, background freezes and gesture loops.
root_cause: The prompt named each actor's general duty but gave the model too much time and did not require measurable per-interval body displacement. The model held the foreground control pose, reduced motion to facial changes, and looped background hand gestures to fill duration.

compiler_guard_clause: TEXT_LAYER_POST_ONLY shots must run PROMPT_LITERAL_GLYPH_SCAN before submission. Strip exact dialogue, labels, medicine names, people, places, accounts, and target glyph strings from the visual prompt; use opaque PROP_IDs and keep exact mappings only in AgentCut.
optimization: Remove every target glyph and exact label string from visual prompts, including semantic object names. Refer to text-bearing props by opaque role IDs; add exact real-font text only in AgentCut.
root_cause: The prompt prohibited labels but still contained a specific Chinese medicine-drawer name. The provider copied those glyphs onto multiple drawer plates, so the negative text instruction could not prevent literal prompt echo.

compiler_guard_clause: Every generated unit must declare exactly one dialogue mode before submission: ON_CAMERA_NATIVE_LIP_SYNC requires visible-speaker audio binding and forbids silent-performance language; CLOSED_MOUTH_VOICE_OVER forbids shot dialogue and keeps exact speech only in a separate voice-over manifest; NO_DIALOGUE forbids both. A silent replacement source may never inherit an old dialogue track while claiming lip sync.
optimization: Compile dialogue intent as a typed contract before visual generation. Generate visible speech with bound reference audio and native lip sync, or author a closed-mouth voice-over shot whose exact text and audio remain outside the visual prompt. Carry the same mode into AgentCut metadata and release QA.
root_cause: An OCR-safe repair changed an on-camera spoken beat into an explicitly silent visual performance, but assembly later reused the old character audio and described it as recovered native dialogue. The picture and audio could carry the same words without matching mouth movement.

compiler_guard_clause: Multi-actor combat requires distinct SHA-bound identity references and a timed combat_choreography_contract. Every 3-second-or-shorter beat must name initiator, target, contact point, force direction, footwork, reaction and end state. Lock winner and restrained actor separately; fail on identity blending, opening freeze, role inversion or the wrong restrained actor regardless of aggregate score.
optimization: Use an independent opponent identity sheet, reference a choreography video for timing and biomechanics only, simplify the fight to contiguous named contacts, require event-related displacement from every visible actor in the first second, and make the final restraint identity explicit.
root_cause: The prompt overloaded one take with ice, powder, spirit projection, paper-wall effects and several exchanges while the assassin had no independent identity reference. Generic per-actor motion prose did not define contact biomechanics or the final restrained identity, allowing frozen supporting actors and protagonist-like opponent blending.

compiler_guard_clause: OCR repair may never use blur, defocus or depth-of-field degradation on evidence, documents, faces, hands or people. Regenerate a genuinely textless source or replace only the text-bearing prop surface with an opaque authored plate; preserve approved subtitle font and outline without an opaque box unless the creative brief explicitly requires one.
optimization: Move text prevention into prompt compilation, use blank prop plates and real-font post layers, and block blur/defocus sources plus unapproved subtitle boxes at AgentCut release validation.
root_cause: OCR cleanup was allowed to optimize only detector success, so broad defocus hid narrative documents and a person. Per-caption black boxes were then added to cover residual generated text, overriding the approved subtitle style.

compiler_guard_clause: Every visible or speaking role, including a one-shot opponent or extra, requires a writer-authored canonical character brief before image generation and a SHA-frozen visual/voice asset after historical and same-episode uniqueness audits. Prompts may consume only those assets; block generic temporary people and fail any face, hair, wardrobe-color or voice drift across keyframes and clips.
optimization: Move temporary-role design into the canonical script manifest. Generate and uniqueness-audit a dedicated identity and voice package before any shot, then bind its SHA and immutable wardrobe/face/hair/voice signatures into every keyframe and video prompt.
root_cause: The E38 script named a functional assassin but did not provide an asset-ready era, wardrobe, face, hair or voice brief. Production therefore generated an ad hoc generic masked man, who resembled principals and changed from black to grey within the sequence.

compiler_guard_clause: Every spoken line requires a psychological state, named emotion and 1-5 intensity, pace, pause map, in-text emphasis words, volume arc, breath pattern, within-line emotional transition and synchronized body action. Preserve the actor's frozen voice identity while rejecting identical prosody signatures across all lines unless the script explicitly requires deliberate monotony.
optimization: Compile line-specific inner objective and audible prosody into both the video prompt and speech request. Vary delivery as information, danger and decisions change while keeping the character voice reference immutable. Require human listening QA for emotional credibility and lip-sync timing.
root_cause: The previous pipeline bound a stable voice reference and exact words but described dialogue only as clear speech. It supplied no line-level psychology, intensity, pauses, emphasis, volume, breath or delivery transition, so the provider reused one neutral cadence and tone across different dramatic states.
